2609.01422.title: From Rollouts to Recipes: Self-Contained Post-Training for LLMs
2609.01422.paper_summary: Post-training large language models usually applies a single training recipe to all samples, even though the model's own rollouts reveal different sample-level learning states. We propose Self-Routing, a behavior-conditioned post-training framework that uses rollout correctness and confidence to decide how each sample should be optimized. Depending on its behavior state, a sample is routed to GRPO, on-policy self-distillation, regularization, or skipping, allowing training to adapt without external teachers, extra annotations, or additional sampling. Experiments on mathematical reasoning across Qwen3 and Qwen3.5 backbones show that Self-Routing consistently improves over uniform GRPO, uniform OPSD, fixed mixtures, and simpler routing baselines. Further analyses show that the routing distribution changes over training and reduces unnecessary updates on low-signal or already stable samples.
2609.01422.paper_summary_zh: 後訓練的大型語言模型通常對所有樣本應用單一的訓練配方，即使模型自身的回饋顯示出不同的樣本級學習狀態。我們提出了自我路由（Self-Routing），這是一種行為條件的後訓練框架，利用回饋的正確性和信心來決定每個樣本應該如何優化。根據其行為狀態，樣本被路由到GRPO、政策內自我蒸餾、正則化或跳過，允許訓練在不需要外部教師、額外註釋或額外取樣的情況下進行調整。在Qwen3和Qwen3.5骨幹上的數學推理實驗顯示，自我路由在均勻GRPO、均勻OPSD、固定混合和更簡單的路由基準上持續改進。進一步的分析顯示，路由分佈在訓練過程中發生變化，並減少對低信號或已穩定樣本的不必要更新。
